sentences.zh: 他当然就是爱德华·哈布斯堡，匈牙利驻圣座大使。

sentences.en: There is no fines on the rest is history.

sentences.zh: 大约两年前《经济学人》上有一篇关于这个的文章，正如你可以想象的那样，这导致了我的Twitter账户上出现了各种关于近亲繁殖的笑话。

sentences.en: So, first of all, yes, it is true that Habsburgs did marry dozens of times between the Austrian and the Spanish branch between the 16th and the 17th century.
sentences.zh: 所以，首先，是的，哈布斯堡家族在16世纪到17世纪之间确实在奥地利分支和西班牙分支之间通婚了数十次，这是真的。

sentences.en: Yes, that's true.
sentences.zh: 是的，那是真的。

sentences.en: And yes, that led to genetic mutations and deformations in the later Habsburgs in the Spanish branch.
sentences.zh: 是的，这确实导致了后来西班牙分支哈布斯堡家族的基因突变和畸形。

sentences.en: However, it's very important to realize that the Habsburg jaw that looks spectacular, it's the lower mandible standing out very strongly, doesn't come from the inbreeding.
sentences.zh: 然而，非常重要的一点是，看起来很壮观的哈布斯堡下巴，即下颌骨非常突出，并不是来自近亲繁殖。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a famous joke, the French diplomat reports home saying that Charles V played tennis.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，有一个著名的笑话，法国外交官报告说查理五世在打网球。

sentences.en: It was jeu de paume at the time, and it rained and the drops came into his mouth.
sentences.zh: 当时是手掌球，下雨了，雨滴落进了他的嘴里。

sentences.en: And he complained to his teacher that the drops came into his mouth.
sentences.zh: 他向老师抱怨说，水滴都滴进他嘴里了。

sentences.en: And the teacher told him, well, then close the mouth, which solved the problem for him.
sentences.zh: 老师告诉他，那就把嘴闭上，这问题就解决了。

sentences.en: Very ironically, he writes all of that.
sentences.zh: 非常讽刺的是，这些都是他自己写的。

sentences.en: So, they had a very, very strong forward jutting lower jaw.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们的下颚非常、非常突出。

sentences.en: But that happened before the Spanish branch even existed.
sentences.zh: 但这在西班牙分支出现之前就已经发生了。

sentences.en: That happened in the generation above Maximilian.
sentences.zh: 那是马克西米利安上一代的事了。

sentences.en: And nobody married any Habsburgs then at that time.
sentences.zh: 当时也没有人与哈布斯堡家族通婚。

sentences.en: It came from Zimburga, who was his, I think, Polish grandmother.
sentences.zh: 这是来自津布尔加，我想应该是他的波兰祖母。

sentences.en: And I suppose it was probably made more prominent, perhaps, by the inbreeding.
sentences.zh: 我想这可能是因为近亲繁殖，才让它变得更加明显。

sentences.en: But it doesn't come from the famous Habsburg inbreeding.
sentences.zh: 但这并不是源于著名的哈布斯堡家族近亲通婚。

sentences.en: Another point I make in my book, too, is that among those 74 marriages, I think it was 74 altogether, over 150 years between Vienna and Madrid, nearly all of them were very,
sentences.zh: 我在书中提到的另一点是，在维也纳和马德里之间150年里的那74桩婚姻中，我想总共是74桩，几乎所有婚姻都非常、

sentences.en: very happy marriages.
sentences.zh: 非常幸福。

sentences.en: Not because they were cousins.
sentences.zh: 不是因为他们是表亲。

sentences.en: But because they had the same set of values, the same faith, the same ideas about marriage, about family.
sentences.zh: 而是因为他们有着相同的价值观、相同的信仰，对婚姻和家庭有着相同的看法。

sentences.en: They had the same sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 他们有着相同的幽默感。

sentences.en: They lived in a very similar cultural world.
sentences.zh: 他们生活在非常相似的文化世界里。

sentences.en: And so, they married someone they never met, but they met somebody who came from a world they could understand.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们虽然与素未谋面的人结婚，但对方来自一个他们能够理解的世界。

sentences.en: To be fair, Edward, we've talked before in the podcast about a very different family who are famous for interbreeding, which is the Ptolemers.
sentences.zh: 公平地说，爱德华，我们之前在播客里谈过另一个以近亲通婚闻名的家族，那就是托勒密家族。

sentences.en: They're descendants of Ptolemy Alexander the Great's friend and kind of captain who take over Egypt.
sentences.zh: 他们是亚历山大大帝的朋友兼将领托勒密的后裔，后来接管了埃及。

sentences.en: And they married each other and then had the most hideous family feuds and sort of always murdering each other and plotting and stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们内部通婚，然后发生了最可怕的家族纷争，总是互相残杀、勾心斗角之类的。

sentences.en: And the Habsburgs never really seemed to have done that, actually.
sentences.zh: 而哈布斯堡家族似乎从来没有那样做过，真的。

sentences.en: When you look at the history, families who dominate history are often famous because they all hate each other.
sentences.zh: 当你审视历史时，那些统治历史的家族往往因为内部仇恨而闻名。

sentences.en: But the Habsburgs are quite unusual in that they do seem to have rubbed along pretty well.
sentences.zh: 但哈布斯堡家族相当不寻常，他们似乎相处得相当融洽。

sentences.en: You think, I mean, I'm not just making another play for the Golden Fleece.
sentences.zh: 你以为，我是说，我不仅仅是在为金羊毛骑士团做宣传。

sentences.en: I think I'm well ahead of you there.
sentences.zh: 我想我在这方面已经领先你了。

sentences.en: There are remarkably few kind of coups, palace plots, conspiracies, all these kinds of things.
sentences.zh: 这里几乎没有什么政变、宫廷阴谋、密谋之类的勾当。

sentences.en: So is there a genuine esprit de corps, do you think, among the Habsburgs at their peak in, I don't know, the 18th or 17th century or whatever?
sentences.zh: 那么你认为，在哈布斯堡家族的鼎盛时期，比如18世纪或17世纪，他们之间是否存在真正的团队精神？

sentences.en: Dominic Flattery will get you anywhere.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克，奉承话能让你无往不利。

sentences.en: Brilliant.
sentences.zh: 精彩。

sentences.en: But you will remember that I complimented your chin.
sentences.zh: 但你得记得我夸过你的下巴。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If you're deciding which of us is to join the Order of the Golden Fleece.
sentences.zh: 如果你正在决定我们俩谁能加入金羊毛骑士团的话。

sentences.en: Just reminding you of that.
sentences.zh: 只是提醒你一下。

sentences.en: So I think there's two reasons why the Habsburgs are an awfully nice family without backstabbing murder and horrible things.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为哈布斯堡家族之所以是一个非常好的家族，没有背后捅刀的谋杀和可怕的事情，有两个原因。

sentences.en: One of them is that from the beginning, they had to look after an incredibly complex set of countries, had to be very diplomatic and couldn't afford power games, violence.
sentences.zh: 其中之一是，从一开始，他们就必须照看一套极其复杂的国家体系，必须非常外交，不能玩弄权术或使用暴力。

sentences.en: There were a few moments where family inside intrigues in the Habsburg family in the early times.
sentences.zh: 早期哈布斯堡家族内部确实有过几次勾心斗角。

sentences.en: But apart from that, they were always, you're absolutely right, a very esprit de corps and they were all Catholic.
sentences.zh: 但除此之外，你说得完全正确，他们一直非常有团队精神，而且他们都是天主教徒。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So this is your second rule, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 所以这是你的第二条准则，对吧？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Your second rule is be a Catholic.
sentences.zh: 你的第二条准则是成为一名天主教徒。

sentences.en: Dominic pulling a very Protestant face at that.
sentences.zh: 多米尼克听到这儿露出了非常新教徒的表情。

sentences.en: So could you just talk through that?
sentences.zh: 那你能不能详细谈谈这个？

sentences.en: Why you think that's significant for the success of the Habsburgs over the sweep of history?
sentences.zh: 为什么你认为这对哈布斯堡家族在整个历史进程中的成功至关重要？

sentences.en: I think that the Habsburgs saw their job being emperor or being architetures married out somewhere as part of the vocation as Catholics and as Christians.
sentences.zh: 我认为哈布斯堡家族将他们作为皇帝或作为联姻对象的工作，视为他们作为天主教徒和基督徒的天职。

sentences.en: And as something they would one day have to render accountability to God in the last judgment.
sentences.zh: 并且认为这是他们终有一天在最后审判时必须向神交代的事情。

sentences.en: Nowadays, we're used to cultural Catholics or salon Catholics or Catholics by baptism.
sentences.zh: 如今，我们习惯了文化天主教徒、沙龙天主教徒或受洗的天主教徒。

sentences.en: But you were a serious Catholic in the 15th, 16th, 17th, 18th century.
sentences.zh: 但在15、16、17、18世纪，你必须是一名虔诚的天主教徒。

sentences.en: Well, 18th century at Enlightenment, things got a bit different.
sentences.zh: 嗯，18世纪启蒙运动时期，情况有所不同。

sentences.en: But the faith was something that shaped your every decision.
sentences.zh: 但信仰是塑造你每一个决定的东西。

sentences.en: And you thought twice about doing something nasty because you knew that you could, of course, go to confession.
sentences.zh: 你会三思而后行，因为你知道自己当然可以去忏悔。

sentences.en: But in the end, God would ask you, you were emperor over your people.
sentences.zh: 但最终，上帝会问你，你是你子民的皇帝。

sentences.en: Did you do this right?
sentences.zh: 你做对了吗？

sentences.en: And this was a serious matter.
sentences.zh: 这是一件严肃的事情。

sentences.en: So the Habsburgs took their faith very serious.
sentences.zh: 所以哈布斯堡家族非常认真地对待他们的信仰。

sentences.en: You could even say a joke like are the Habsburgs Catholic is almost like is the Pope Catholic.
sentences.zh: 你甚至可以说，像“哈布斯堡家族是天主教徒吗”这样的笑话，几乎就像问“教皇是天主教徒吗”一样。

sentences.en: They were always Catholic and they still are.
sentences.zh: 他们一直都是天主教徒，现在依然是。

sentences.en: I may add our like four to five hundred family members that still hang around.
sentences.zh: 我可以补充一下，我们还有四五百名家庭成员依然活跃着。

sentences.en: Most of us are active Catholics, devout Catholics.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人都是积极的、虔诚的天主教徒。

sentences.en: We still have lots of children.
sentences.zh: 我们依然有很多孩子。

sentences.en: So it's something that shaped our family a lot.
sentences.zh: 所以这在很大程度上塑造了我们的家族。

sentences.en: And I guess I believe that it led to the harmonious parts of our family history.
sentences.zh: 我想我相信这带来了我们家族史上和谐的一面。

sentences.en: Can I just ask about one very celebrated Habsburg who seems not to have been perhaps as orthodox in his Catholicism as he might have been.
sentences.zh: 我能问一下关于一位非常著名的哈布斯堡成员吗？他似乎在天主教信仰上并不像他本应表现得那样正统。

sentences.en: And that is Rudolf II.
sentences.zh: 那就是鲁道夫二世。

sentences.en: He's based in Prague, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 他住在布拉格，对吧？

sentences.en: Towards the end of the 16th century.
sentences.zh: 在16世纪末。

sentences.en: And he's a great enthusiast for alchemy and secret rites and all kinds of things like that.
sentences.zh: 他非常热衷于炼金术、秘密仪式以及各种类似的事情。

sentences.en: And he refused the sacrament on his deathbed, didn't he?
sentences.zh: 而且他在临终时拒绝了圣礼，不是吗？

sentences.en: He had no time for all this.
sentences.zh: 他没时间搞这些。

sentences.en: Let's carry on.
sentences.zh: 我们继续吧。

sentences.en: He and his father both did that.
sentences.zh: 他和他的父亲都那样做了。

sentences.en: Very, very dark moment in our family history.
sentences.zh: 这是我们家族史上非常、非常黑暗的时刻。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So they're the dark sheep.
sentences.zh: 所以他们是害群之马。

sentences.en: In a way they are.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上是的。

sentences.en: In a way they are.
sentences.zh: 某种程度上是的。

sentences.en: And I regularly pray for them.
sentences.zh: 我经常为他们祈祷。

sentences.en: On the other hand, it was difficult to be a Holy Roman Emperor in a moment where Protestantism and the Reformation broke into the German lands.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，在宗教改革和新教进入德意志地区的时候，想要做一个神圣罗马帝国皇帝是很困难的。

sentences.en: And I mean, the Holy Roman Empire was mostly centered around the German speaking lands.
sentences.zh: 我是说，神圣罗马帝国主要集中在德语区。

sentences.en: And half of your princes suddenly were Protestant.
sentences.zh: 而你的一半诸侯突然变成了新教徒。

sentences.en: And you somehow had to come to grips with that and somehow had to live with that situation.
sentences.zh: 你必须以某种方式应对，并以某种方式适应那种局面。

sentences.en: And people like later Ferdinand II, they sort of stood strong and even too strong.
sentences.zh: 像后来的斐迪南二世那样的人，他们立场坚定，甚至过于坚定。

sentences.en: I mean, people hated them.
sentences.zh: 我是说，人们恨他们。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I was going to say Ferdinand II.
sentences.zh: 我正想说斐迪南二世。

sentences.en: I mean, he's ultra-Catholic, isn't he?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他是极度虔诚的天主教徒，对吧？

sentences.en: He's identified with the Counter-Reformation.
sentences.zh: 他被视为反宗教改革的代表。

sentences.en: He's one of the great protagonists of the Thirty Years' War.
sentences.zh: 他是三十年战争中的伟大主角之一。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: But maybe, Edward, you will say I've been reading too much Protestant historiography because in a lot of the histories of the Thirty Years' War,
sentences.zh: 但也许，爱德华，你会说我读了太多的新教史学，因为在许多关于三十年战争的历史中，

sentences.en: the implication is if he had been less Catholic, if he had been less insistent on orthodoxy and maybe more tolerant of the Protestant princes,
sentences.zh: 暗示着如果他少一点天主教色彩，如果他少一点对正统的坚持，也许对新教诸侯更宽容一些，

sentences.en: the great bloodbath of the Thirty Years' War might not have unfolded.
sentences.zh: 三十年战争那场大屠杀可能就不会发生了。

sentences.en: Now, I know I'm talking myself out now of that honor, but I'm going to stick with it anyway.
sentences.zh: 现在，我知道我正在推翻自己的观点，但我还是要坚持下去。

sentences.en: Keep going, Dominic.
sentences.zh: 继续说，多米尼克。

sentences.en: Keep digging.
sentences.zh: 继续深挖。

sentences.en: So what's your take on Ferdinand II?
sentences.zh: 那么你对斐迪南二世有什么看法？

sentences.en: Because you did hint there that he might have been too Catholic.
sentences.zh: 因为你刚才暗示他可能过于天主教化了。

sentences.en: I'm a diplomat and my heart tells me he was a good Catholic emperor.
sentences.zh: 我是一名外交官，我的内心告诉我他是一位虔诚的天主教皇帝。

sentences.en: The diplomat in me sees that he could have achieved things like Kissinger says in his book on diplomacy,
sentences.zh: 我作为外交官的那一面认为，他本可以像基辛格在《外交》一书中所说的那样取得成就，

sentences.en: where he says the absolute not understanding by Richelieu how Ferdinand could be so stupid not to make small steps to achieve something for Austria.
sentences.zh: 书中提到黎塞留完全无法理解斐迪南怎么会如此愚蠢，不采取小步走的方式为奥地利争取利益。

sentences.en: The Catholic in me says, because Ferdinand remained firm, Austria is still Catholic.
sentences.zh: 我作为天主教徒的那一面则说，正因为斐迪南立场坚定，奥地利至今仍是天主教国家。

sentences.en: The diplomat in me says, well, he could have made some agreements and perhaps we would have had less problems also with Prague and with Bohemia and with these parts of the event.
sentences.zh: 我作为外交官的那一面说，好吧，他本可以达成一些协议，也许我们在布拉格、波希米亚以及这些事件的后续中遇到的问题会少一些。

sentences.en: So we don't know.
sentences.zh: 所以我们不知道。

sentences.en: It went the way it went.
sentences.zh: 事情就这样发生了。

sentences.en: If you look at the history of Ferdinand II and the way he was raised, educated, shaped, the vows he made to keep Austria Catholic, he couldn't have gone any other way.
sentences.zh: 如果你看看斐迪南二世的历史，看看他的成长、教育、塑造过程，以及他为保持奥地利天主教信仰所立下的誓言，他不可能走别的路。

sentences.en: In my book, I say, I think that he did the right thing.
sentences.zh: 在我的书中，我说我认为他做了正确的事。

sentences.en: Of course, I do because I'm a Habsburg.
sentences.zh: 当然，我这么说是因为我是哈布斯堡家族的人。

sentences.en: But as I said, the diplomat in me understands your position.
sentences.zh: 但正如我所说，我作为外交官的那一面理解你的立场。

sentences.en: But we can rarely ask the question, what would have happened if?
sentences.zh: 但我们很少能问“如果……会怎样”这样的问题。

sentences.en: It's not allowed to historians.
sentences.zh: 历史学家是不允许这样做的。

sentences.en: We, for instance, could ask if Franz Ferdinand's car wouldn't have stopped and turned around at exactly that point where Gavrilo Princip, by coincidence,
sentences.zh: 例如，我们可以问，如果弗朗茨·斐迪南的车没有在加夫里洛·普林西普第一次暗杀失败后，恰好走到那个点时停下并掉头，

sentences.en: was walking after his first attempt.
sentences.zh: 当时他正好在那儿徘徊。

sentences.en: Imagine, no First World War.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，没有第一次世界大战。

sentences.en: Two years later, Emperor Franz Ferdinand with a very balanced view of the Slavic people in his empire.
sentences.zh: 两年后，弗朗茨·斐迪南皇帝会对帝国境内的斯拉夫民族持有一种非常平衡的看法。

sentences.en: No Germany, humiliated by Versailles.
sentences.zh: 没有被《凡尔赛条约》羞辱的德国。

sentences.en: No fertile ground for Hitler.
sentences.zh: 没有希特勒滋生的土壤。

sentences.en: No Second World War.
sentences.zh: 没有第二次世界大战。

sentences.en: Imagine, but you can't do that.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，但你不能那样做。

sentences.en: This is music to my ears.
sentences.zh: 这简直是天籁之音。

sentences.en: We should have done a deal and turned on the French.
sentences.zh: 我们本应该达成协议，然后转而对付法国人。

sentences.en: So that actually kind of leads us on to the third point that you make, which is believe in empire and subsidiarity.
sentences.zh: 所以这实际上引出了你提出的第三点，即相信帝国和辅助性原则。

sentences.en: Now, subsidiarity is a word that's very popular in the EU, isn't it?
sentences.zh: 现在，“辅助性原则”是一个在欧盟非常流行的词，不是吗？

sentences.en: The idea that you kind of cede power back to the various parts of the imperial entity.
sentences.zh: 即把权力下放回帝国实体各个部分的理念。

sentences.en: But enthusiasm for empire isn't something that you tend to get these days.
sentences.zh: 但如今人们对帝国并没有什么热情。

sentences.en: So what's the justification for empire?
sentences.zh: 那么帝国的正当性何在？

sentences.en: In my book, I speak about the difference between the empire in Star Wars and in Dune, in the Dune novels, and of course in the movie too.
sentences.zh: 在我的书中，我谈到了《星球大战》和《沙丘》小说（当然还有电影）中帝国之间的区别。

sentences.en: Our idea of empire is a ruthless power grab by one emperor over many, many different countries that are all uniform places where armies enforce obedience.
sentences.zh: 我们对帝国的印象是一个皇帝对许多不同国家的无情权力掠夺，这些国家都是统一的场所，军队在那里强制执行服从。

sentences.en: And then a band of rebels, Luke Skywalker, et cetera, fight against that.
sentences.zh: 然后是一群反抗军，卢克·天行者之类的人，与此抗争。

sentences.en: The Holy Roman Empire was very different.

sentences.en: Yes, that exact moment.
sentences.zh: 没错，就是那一刻。

sentences.zh: 不过，正如你所说，法国人在下一场战役中确实赢了。

sentences.en: Yes.

sentences.en: I think we should all think a bit more about death.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们都应该多思考一下死亡。

sentences.en: It gives you a life perspective.
sentences.zh: 它能让你对人生有更深刻的认识。

sentences.zh: 它让你审视自己所做的一切是否真的重要。

sentences.en: And, of course, as a Catholic, I know that the moment of my death, besides also, among other things, about the way I will spend eternity, the Habsburgs were very aware of that.
sentences.zh: 当然，作为一名天主教徒，我知道我临终的那一刻，除了其他事情之外，还关乎我将如何度过永恒，哈布斯堡家族对此非常清楚。

sentences.en: I'm just trying to bring that point home.
sentences.zh: 我只是想强调这一点。

sentences.en: And I've seen this put in practice because I was present at the funeral of Empress Zita when she died and of Otto von Habsburg, where they both times did this famous Habsburg
sentences.zh: 我亲眼见过这种做法，因为我参加了齐塔皇后去世时的葬礼，也参加了奥托·冯·哈布斯堡的葬礼，他们两次都举行了著名的哈布斯堡

sentences.en: knocking ritual.
sentences.zh: 敲门仪式。

sentences.en: You have a lovely description of that in your book.
sentences.zh: 你的书里对这个仪式有很棒的描述。

sentences.en: So, this is at the Capuchin Crypt.
sentences.zh: 所以，这是在嘉布遣会地下室。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: In Vienna, in the Neumarkt, in the center of the city.
sentences.zh: 在维也纳，在新集市广场，在市中心。

sentences.en: So, tell us about the knocking ritual.
sentences.zh: 那么，给我们讲讲这个敲门仪式吧。

sentences.en: What happens?
sentences.zh: 发生了什么？

sentences.en: The knocking ritual, first of all, you can watch it on YouTube.
sentences.zh: 首先，你可以在YouTube上观看敲门仪式。

sentences.en: There are videos both of Zita's and of Otto's funeral.
sentences.zh: 有齐塔和奥托葬礼的视频。

sentences.en: And you arrive with a coffin at that church, which is on the Neumarkt.
sentences.zh: 你带着棺材来到位于新集市广场的那座教堂。

sentences.en: You knock at the door that leads down the stairs to the crypt.
sentences.zh: 你敲响通往地下室楼梯的那扇门。

sentences.en: And then you have a voice from inside, a Capuchin, who guard, of course, the bodies of the Habsburgs in the crypt, asks who is there.
sentences.zh: 然后里面会传来一个声音，是一位嘉布遣会修士，当然，他们守护着地下室里哈布斯堡家族成员的遗体，他会问是谁在外面。

sentences.en: And then the master of ceremony reads out the titles of the emperor, just as you did at the beginning of the show.
sentences.zh: 然后司仪会宣读皇帝的头衔，就像你在节目开头做的那样。

sentences.en: And the voice answers, we don't know him.
sentences.zh: 那个声音回答说：我们不认识他。

sentences.en: And then they knock again, and they read out all the achievements the emperor has done in his life.
sentences.zh: 然后他们再次敲门，宣读皇帝一生中取得的所有成就。

sentences.en: And again, the voice answers, we don't know him.
sentences.zh: 那个声音再次回答说：我们不认识他。

sentences.en: And the third knock comes, who is there?
sentences.zh: 第三次敲门声响起，问是谁在外面？

sentences.en: And then they would say, Zita, a poor, sinful woman.
sentences.zh: 然后他们会说：齐塔，一个可怜的、有罪的女人。

sentences.en: And then the door opens.
sentences.zh: 接着门就开了。

sentences.en: And that is the Habsburg attitude towards death in a nutshell.
sentences.zh: 这就是哈布斯堡家族对待死亡的态度，简而言之。

sentences.en: I give a few very nice examples, a few grandiose ones with Emperor Maximilian, the way he disposed his body to be treated.
sentences.zh: 我举了几个非常好的例子，比如马克西米利安皇帝，他对自己遗体的处理方式就非常宏大。

sentences.en: That's an amazing story.
sentences.zh: 那真是一个了不起的故事。

sentences.en: He demanded that all his teeth be taken out, his hair cut off, and then his body was to be whipped and covered with lime and ash.
sentences.zh: 他要求拔掉他所有的牙齿，剪掉头发，然后鞭打他的遗体，并撒上石灰和骨灰。

sentences.en: What's all that about?
sentences.zh: 这到底是怎么回事？

sentences.en: Or is that perfectly reasonable in your way of thinking?
sentences.zh: 还是说在你的思维方式里，这完全是合理的？

sentences.en: We all do that.
sentences.zh: 我们都会那样做。

sentences.en: I think it was, as I told you, the Habsburgs were very aware that their life was being seen for many people like an example, like a sermon.
sentences.zh: 我认为正如我告诉你的那样，哈布斯堡家族非常清楚，他们的生活被许多人视为一种榜样，一种布道。

sentences.en: So, with every gesture around his funeral, he wanted to encourage people to die like a good Christian.
sentences.zh: 所以，他葬礼上的每一个举动，都是为了鼓励人们像一个好的基督徒那样死去。

sentences.en: And this was a sign of humility.
sentences.zh: 这是一种谦卑的象征。

sentences.en: I was the emperor, but I'm only a poor sinner, probably in purgatory for what I did in my life.
sentences.zh: 我曾是皇帝，但我只是一个可怜的罪人，可能因为我生前所做的一切而在炼狱中受苦。

sentences.en: And he wanted to make that visible.
sentences.zh: 他想让这一点显而易见。

sentences.en: The other thing that he did was the way he was buried in the steps under the altar in
sentences.zh: 他做的另一件事是他被安葬在维也纳新城祭坛下的台阶里，

sentences.en: Wiener Neustadt, which I saw for the first time last year, which is you have steps leading up to the altar.
sentences.zh: 我去年第一次看到，就是通往祭坛的台阶。

sentences.en: And in the second step, there's just the word Maximilian.
sentences.zh: 在第二级台阶上，只写着“马克西米利安”这个词。

sentences.en: There is no huge sarcophagus.
sentences.zh: 没有巨大的石棺。

sentences.en: There is no image.
sentences.zh: 没有雕像。

sentences.en: It's just his name.
sentences.zh: 只有他的名字。

sentences.en: And he wanted to be buried under the altar.
sentences.zh: 他想被安葬在祭坛下。

sentences.en: So, the priest would say mass above his chest and pray for him.
sentences.zh: 这样，牧师会在他的胸口上方做弥撒，为他祈祷。

sentences.en: And probably the most famous Habsburg death of all is the youngest daughter of Maria Theresa,
sentences.zh: 可能最著名的哈布斯堡家族死亡事件是玛丽亚·特蕾莎最小的女儿，

sentences.en: Maria Antonia, but better known as Marie Antoinette.
sentences.zh: 玛丽亚·安东尼亚，也就是更广为人知的玛丽·安托瓦内特。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: That's such a story.
sentences.zh: 真是个故事。

sentences.en: Terreur.
sentences.zh: 恐怖统治。

sentences.en: By the way, a book everybody should read.
sentences.zh: 顺便说一句，这是一本每个人都应该读的书。

sentences.en: It's incredible.
sentences.zh: 太不可思议了。

sentences.zh: 他坐在摇摇晃晃前往刑场的小车上，她非常不开心，很紧张，一直在环顾四周的房子，他不明白为什么。

sentences.zh: 然后她经过一所房子，她的脸亮了起来。

sentences.zh: 从那时起，她内心平静了。

sentences.zh: 她以绝对的平静走向了刑场。

sentences.zh: 那是什么房子？

sentences.zh: 他什么也没发现。

sentences.zh: 她死前不被允许忏悔，对于哈布斯堡家族和天主教徒来说，

sentences.en: So she had been told that a bishop would be standing at one of the houses and the window and give her the absolution in extremis from that window.

sentences.zh: 当她看到那位主教给她赦免时，她知道一切都好了。

sentences.zh: 她带着与上帝的和平走向了死亡。

sentences.zh: 你的书是《哈布斯堡之路：动荡时代的七条规则》。
